# Check: upstream overlay-short-content.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-short-content.test.ts

## Subject
TUI overlay rendering when content is shorter than the terminal.

## Upstream test count (approx)
1

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- renders overlay when content is shorter than terminal height (regression — 24-row terminal, 3-line content, overlay should center around row 10)

## Upstream dependencies
Component, TUI, VirtualTerminal

## Upstream notes
Regression test for overlay visibility with short content.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/overlay_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list the missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-short-content.test.ts (1 integration test)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/overlay_test.exs (25 tests — all pure unit tests)

## Analysis

Upstream is a **regression integration test**: construct a TUI with a 24-row terminal, add a 3-line child, call showOverlay(), start(), waitForRender(), then assert the overlay is visible in the viewport. It verifies the TUI render pipeline renders overlays when child content is shorter than terminal height.

Our overlay_test.exs tests Overlay.anchor_row/anchor_col/resolve_and_clip/composite/composite_line at the pure-function level. It does not exercise the TUI → child → overlay render path end-to-end. Short-vs-tall-content is not a distinguishing variable at the function level.

## UNMAPPED

- Regression: overlay is visible through the full TUI render pipeline when child content is shorter than terminal height (24 rows terminal, 3 lines content, overlay centered around row 10). No Elixir integration test covers this.

Note: tui_render_test.exs exists (untracked file listed in git status) — may or may not cover this; the processing agent should verify.

## N/A / EXTRA

Elixir unit tests are strictly broader than upstream at the function level; the upstream file only tests integration behavior.

## Action

Creating a compliance ticket for an integration-level regression test.
